name: Ma Stonefield
summary: At Stonefield Farm in western Elwynn, Ma Stonefield tends to hardships close to home. Beside Auntie Bernice, she faces farm troubles, neighboring rivalries, and pests.

sections.title: Homestead Troubles
sections.body: Ma Stonefield watches over the farm beside her family cottage in southwestern Elwynn Forest, with Auntie Bernice Stonefield at her side. The neighboring Maclure homestead and nearby pumpkin patches bring little peace. Wild boars threaten the Stonefield crops, and Princess causes the greatest trouble. The enormous prize sow tramples fields and devours the harvest the family worked hard to grow.

faq.answer: Ma Stonefield is an elder of the Stonefield family, living at their farmstead in southwestern Elwynn Forest with relatives such as Auntie Bernice.

faq.q: Where can I find Ma Stonefield?
faq.answer: Ma Stonefield stands outdoors in front of the main house at Stonefield Farm, west of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What problem does Ma Stonefield need solved?
faq.answer: Ma Stonefield wants help stopping Princess, a massive prize pig that repeatedly rampages through nearby fields and devours local crops.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer in Elwynn Forest, helping hardworking homesteaders like Ma Stonefield helps protect Stormwind's agricultural backbone.
